name: Napa Cabbage
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated for SIBO as it's low in fermentable carbohydrates. Start with smaller portions if very sensitive.
preparationTips: Can be eaten raw in salads or coleslaw
Great for stir-frying - retains crunch when lightly cooked
Use outer leaves for wrapping proteins or rice
Add to soups in final minutes to maintain texture
nutritionalHighlights: High in vitamin C and K
Low in calories and high in water content
